profile_text.body:
Accenture plc is a public company headquartered in Dublin and traded under the ticker ACN, with CIK 0001467373. Its site describes the company as embracing change to create 360-degree value and shared success for clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities, and says it works across industries and around the world using emerging technologies and human ingenuity.

Much of the site's material is framed around AI. Accenture writes about redesigning work, accelerating skills and reinventing HR so that people and AI work together, and about what it calls the Human + AI era. It also publishes on AI tokenomics, AI ROI and enterprise AI economics, on data center power demand that it says is pushing beyond grid limits and on a power-first strategy for developers, and on cyber resilience in an AI driven threat landscape, where it points to 5 actions for leaders. The site also states that Accenture helps the European Commission's Directorate-General for International Partnerships to scale AI across global operations.

The record holds no AI products, no litigation and no MCP servers for the company.
